items.docs:
Use this endpoint to categorize, cleanse, and classify transactions. These transactions are not persisted or stored on the MX platform.

For more information on returned data, please see the [Enhanced Transactions fields guide](/api-reference/platform-api/reference/transactions-overview#enhanced-transactions).

params.description: The unique identifier for a `user`, beginning with the prefix `USR-`.

params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `1000`. If the value exceeds `1000`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Filter transactions from this date. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 120 days ago if not provided.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Filter transactions to this date (at midnight). This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 5 days forward from the day the request is made to capture pending transactions.

params.name: from_created_at
params.description: Filter transactions from the date the transaction was created. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum date range limit is 6 months.

params.name: to_created_at
params.description: Filter transaction to the date in which the transaction was created. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum date range limit is 6 months.

params.name: from_updated_at
params.description: Filter transactions from the date in which the transaction was updated. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum date range limit is 6 months.

params.name: to_updated_at
params.description: Filter transactions to the date in which the transaction was updated. This only supports ISO 8601 format without timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum date range limit is 6 months.

params.name: category_guid[]

params.name: top_level_category_guid[]
params.description:

params.name: includes
params.description:
Options for enhanced transactions. This query parameter is optional. Possible additional metadata: `repeating_transactions`, `merchants`, `classifications`, `geolocations`. The query value is format sensitive. To retrieve all available enhancements, append:

`?includes=repeating_transactions,merchants,classifications,geolocations`. 
 
The query options may be combined to specific enhancements. For example, to request Repeating Transactions and Geolocation data, use: 

`?includes=repeating_transactions,geolocations`.

- Repeating Transactions: Identifies transactions with predictable recurrence patterns (e.g., Bill, Income, Subscription).
- Merchants: Enriches transactions with merchant name.
- Classifications: Provides more insight into the type of money movement that is occurring on the transaction, whether it be retail or investments.
- Geolocation: Provides geographic metadata.

params.name: tag_guid
params.description: The unique id for a `tag`.

params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `1000`. If the value exceeds `1000`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Filter transactions from this date. This only supports unix timestamp format. Defaults to 120 days ago if not provided.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Filter transactions to this date (at midnight). This only supports unix timestamp format. Defaults to 5 days forward from the day the request is made to capture pending transactions.

params.name: from_created_at
params.description: Filter transactions from the date the transaction was created. This only supports unix timestamp format.

params.name: to_created_at
params.description: Filter transaction to the date in which the transaction was created. This only supports unix timestamp format.

params.name: from_updated_at
params.description: Filter transactions from the date in which the transaction was updated. This only supports unix timestamp format.

params.name: to_updated_at
params.description: Filter transactions to the date in which the transaction was updated. This only supports unix timestamp format.

params.name: includes
params.description:
Options for enhanced transactions. This query parameter is optional. Possible additional metadata: `repeating_transactions`, `merchants`, `classifications`, `geolocations`. The query value is format sensitive. To retrieve all available enhancements, append:

`?includes=repeating_transactions,merchants,classifications,geolocations`. 
 
The query options may be combined to specific enhancements. For example, to request Repeating Transactions and Geolocation data, use: 

`?includes=repeating_transactions,geolocations`.

- Repeating Transactions: Identifies transactions with predictable recurrence patterns (e.g., Bill, Income, Subscription).
- Merchants: Enriches transactions with merchant name.
- Classifications: Provides more insight into the type of money movement that is occurring on the transaction, whether it be retail or investments.
- Geolocation: Provides geographic metadata.

Requests to this endpoint return a list of transactions associated with the specified `user`, across all members and accounts associated with that `user`.

Enhanced transaction data may be requested using the `includes` parameter. To use this optional parameter, the value should include the optional metadata requested such as `repeating_transactions`, `merchants`, `classifications`, `geolocations`. For more information, see the Optional Enhancement Query Parameter guide.
